exposure: maternal vascular malperfusion (e.g., abruption, infarct, distal villous hypoplasia, ischemia, decidual necrosis)
fetal vascular malperfusion (e.g., thrombosis, fetal hypoxia, hydrops parenchyma)
cohort: This study included 591 neonates with a gestational age of less than or equal to 32 weeks or a birthweight of less than or equal to 1500 g.
finding: Distal villous hypoplasia, severe acute histological chorioamnionitis, and funisitis were independently associated with an increased risk of retinopathy of prematurity.
